citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
One female Fennec fox (DOB 06-June-2026) is non-weight bearing on the left hind leg. The fox held the leg off the
ground while moving and standing during the entire time the inspectors observed the animal. The licensee stated that the
fox got into a fight with its littermates the night before. The veterinarian has not been contacted concerning the condition
of the fox’s leg and no treatment has been provided. Failure to bear weight on a leg may indicate a painful underlying
health condition and failure to communicate this issue to the attending veterinarian could delay treatment and allow the
condition to worsen.
Each dealer shall ensure direct and frequent communication with the attending veterinarian is timely and accurate. The
licensee must have the fox evaluated by a veterinarian for an accurate diagnosis and to develop an effective treatment
plan. The licensee must ensure that all concerns and problems pertaining to animal health and behavior are
communicated to the attending veterinarian in a timely manner.
To be corrected by: 23-July-2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
Additional Inspectors:
Sarah Roloff n
